cards.text: Friend, this is the account of Aaron and Moses, from the time the LORD spoke with Moses, Israel's leader, on Mount Sinai. It starts with the family of Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14). Four sons: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

cards.question: Aaron's four sons are anointed and ordained to serve as ___.

cards.text: But this family has a hard chapter. Nadab and Abihu died in the presence of the LORD, out in the Wilderness of Sinai.

cards.question: What were Nadab and Abihu doing when they died before the LORD?
Nadab and Abihu left sons behind to serve as priests in their place.

cards.text: No sons. So while their father Aaron is alive, only Eleazar and Ithamar serve as priests.
Then the LORD tells Moses to bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest.

cards.question: Moses presents the tribe of Levi to Aaron so they can take over the priesthood from him.

cards.text: The Levites will serve Aaron and the whole congregation in front of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron gets a WHOLE TRIBE of helpers at once, and I'm not jealous, friend, I'm just a LITTLE jealous.

cards.question: Along with serving at the tabernacle, what will the Levites take care of?

answers.text: The furnishings of the Tent of Meeting
The flocks and herds of Israel

cards.text: The Levites are assigned to Aaron and his sons, given to him from among the Israelites. And Moses is to appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood.

cards.question: God says anyone in Israel is welcome to walk right up to the tabernacle.

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses again: "Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel…" Taken them in place of somebody.

cards.question: The LORD says He took the Levites in place of every ___ Israelite.

cards.text: The Levites belong to Him, because all the firstborn are His. And He points back to one day in Egypt.

cards.question: The LORD speaks of one day in Egypt when He set apart Israel's firstborn for Himself. What else did He do in Egypt that day?

answers.text: Parted the waters of the sea

cards.question: On the day the LORD struck down Egypt's firstborn, He set apart Israel's firstborn animals as well as its firstborn people.

cards.text: Then in the Wilderness of Sinai, the LORD tells Moses to count the Levites by their families and clans.

cards.question: Which Levite males does the LORD tell Moses to count?

answers.text: Every male a month old or more

cards.text: So Moses counts them, just as the LORD commanded. A MONTH old, friend, and that little guy is on the roster before he can even hold his own head up.

Levi's three sons are Gershon, Kohath and Merari, and each son's clans get counted, get a leader and get a side of the tabernacle to camp on. The Gershonites camp on the west and look after the tent, its covering and the curtains, and the Kohathites camp on the south and care for the ark, the table, the lampstand and the altars. The Merarites camp on the north and handle the frames, posts, tent pegs and ropes. Hey. Somebody's gotta bring the pegs.
Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons camp on the east, toward the sunrise, right in front of the Tent of Meeting. Any outsider who approaches the sanctuary is to be put to death.

cards.question: Camped east of the tabernacle, what do Moses, Aaron and Aaron's sons do on behalf of the Israelites?

answers.text: Perform the duties of the sanctuary
Guard the gates of the camp

cards.text: The Levite total comes to 22,000. Then the LORD tells Moses to count every firstborn male of the Israelites, a month old or more, and to take the Levites for Him in place of all Israel's firstborn.

cards.question: The LORD also takes the Levites' livestock in place of the firstborn of the Israelites' livestock.
Moses counts the firstborn, just as the LORD commanded. Next to the 22,000 Levites, what does the firstborn count show?

cards.text: 22,273 firstborn, which is 273 more than the Levites. Friend, when ONE cookie in a batch doesn't fit on the tray, I'm running laps around the bakery, and Moses has 273 left over.
The LORD speaks to Moses again: take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel. And for the 273 extra firstborn, there's a way to redeem them.

cards.question: What's the price to redeem each of the 273 extra firstborn?
The LORD says the redemption money goes to ___ and his ___.
Moses collects the redemption money from all 22,273 of Israel's firstborn.

cards.text: So Moses collects 1,365 shekels by the sanctuary shekel, five times 273 right on the nose, and gives it to Aaron and his sons, just as the LORD commanded. Me, I lose count of chocolate chips at SEVEN.
